electricity_benchmarks.notes: State/distributor residential-market benchmarks for screening only. Site tariff, retailer contract, project tariff, or customer-supplied rate overrides these values.

electricity_price_update.note: Electricity is a screening/site-tariff assumption, not a true weekly commodity update. Use site tariff when supplied. UK default uses the latest DESNZ non-domestic average including Climate Change Levy (~24p/kWh); US default uses $0.18/kWh screening assumption until regional utility data is supplied; AU default uses A$0.30/kWh as a national screening midpoint with Canstar state/distributor consumer-market benchmarks available for context.

events.source_name: Canstar electricity cost per kWh guide
events.message: Use Canstar state/distributor values for screening context only. Site tariff, retailer contract, project tariff, or customer-supplied rate overrides.

UK: UK diesel uses GOV.UK weekly road fuel prices.
UK electricity default uses the latest DESNZ non-domestic average including Climate Change Levy as a quarterly official benchmark.
For UK customer output, site electricity tariff, supplier contract, or customer-supplied rate overrides the benchmark.
AU: AU diesel uses GlobalPetrolPrices as a third-party benchmark updater, not an official government rate. Site/partner diesel price overrides it.
AU electricity default is A$0.30/kWh as a national screening midpoint; Canstar state/distributor benchmarks are third-party consumer-market context, not site tariffs.
AU BESS and generator hire rates are intentionally empty until region-specific partner rates are supplied.
For AU customer output, ask for site diesel price, site electricity tariff, and local hire rates when missing.
CA: Canada region routing is enabled for country/city/province mentions and [CA]/[CANADA] demo overrides.
Canada rates are screening placeholders in CAD until AMPD or partner Canadian commercial rates are supplied.
For Canada customer output, ask for province, site diesel price, electricity tariff, and local hire rates when missing.
